generation.reference_role: Composition, palette, lighting and rendering reference for a newly generated replacement; not recovered original artwork.

manual_visual_review.scope: One reference frame and one generated full image; not entire insertion or motion comparison.
observed: Central woman, right man, rear-left man and dark near-edge pedestrian silhouettes preserve the scene composition.
Navy/cobalt sky, dark silhouettes, cream-white blouse, warm gold/peach light and lavender pavement are represented.
No subtitle, caption backing or added watermark is visibly present.
New character poses, buildings, lighting strengths and painted surface details differ; this is a replacement candidate.

limits: The output is newly generated from a reference. It does not establish the original artist, source file or original generation method.
The provider returned its own raster dimensions despite the requested full-HD minimum; the compositor must scale proportionally and this is recorded explicitly.
No motion, audio, subtitle timing or full-video validation is implied.
